title: Lament over the King of Tyre
description: The Lord's word comes to Ezekiel with a lament over the king of Tyre. He is described as the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and beauty, and was in Eden, God's garden, covered with precious stones. As an anointed cherub he walked on God's holy mountain among the stones of fire. But through his great trade he became filled with violence and sinned, and his heart grew proud because of his beauty. Therefore he was defiled, driven away from God's mountain and cast to the earth. Fire went out from within him and consumed him, and he became ash in the sight of all, a terror to the nations.
